hook.say: True or false? Five more facts about Europe, three seconds each. Careful with the very last one!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Venice is built on more than 100 islands.
questions.fact: The city spreads across roughly 120 small islands linked by bridges.
questions.sayAnswer: True! The city spreads across roughly 120 small islands linked by bridges.

questions.q: Switzerland is a member of the European Union.
questions.fact: Switzerland sits in the middle of the EU but has never joined.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Switzerland is surrounded by the European Union but has never joined.

questions.q: Italy completely surrounds two other countries.
questions.fact: San Marino and Vatican City both lie entirely inside Italy.
questions.sayAnswer: True! San Marino and Vatican City both lie entirely inside Italy.

questions.q: London is farther north than Calgary, Canada.
questions.fact: London sits at 51.5° north. Calgary is at 51.0° north.
questions.sayAnswer: True! London is about half a degree of latitude north of Calgary.

questions.q: Holland is the official name of the Netherlands.
questions.fact: Holland is only a region: two of the country's twelve provinces.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Holland is only a region on the country's west coast.
